clips.title: The story
paras: In Undercity, the Deathstalkers bring a new operative into their ranks. You carry Andron's Ledger to Varimathras, proof of the Syndicate's covert activities.

Mennet Carkad welcomes you into the Deathstalkers after you uncover records from Andron Gant. The order serves Lady Sylvanas as eyes, ears, and daggers throughout Lordaeron. Its agents use intelligence networks, ruthless efficiency, and stealth to remove threats before they surface. Recognition by the order marks a step into service for the Forsaken.

You deliver the sensitive ledger directly to Varimathras in the Royal Quarter of Undercity. The nathrezim commander oversees Forsaken tactical intelligence under Sylvanas Windrunner. Pleased by the Deathstalkers' initiative, Varimathras welcomes your demonstrated ability and says his intelligence division can use someone who delivers results.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Syndicate? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.
Lord Varimathras will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.
Ah, and how could I forget?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, this is interesting. The Deathstalkers have performed their duties admirably in ferreting this out.
From what I understand, you also deserve commendation for your performance. I hope that this will become routine for you, friend, my Deathstalkers always have use of a good man.
